BiblicalUsage: God says, I will take of the highest branch of the high cedar, and will set it, and I will crop off from the top of his young twigs a tender one, and will plant it upon an high mountain and eminent. The word is to pile up, to elevate, to set on high. It appears once, in the promise of a tender twig planted where no man would plant it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the tender twig is the gospel in Ezekiel's picture: God takes the highest branch and plants a tender one, and the high mountain is His own doing, not ours.
